meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Bilkul. **Indian skin tones par white cast avoid karna hai**, toh main generally lightweight chemical/hybrid sunscreen choose karunga.

### 🥇 Meri top pick: Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++
### [Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++ Sunscreen]()
*₹379.10*

- **SPF 50 PA++++**
- White cast ke bina blend hone ke liye popular
- Daily use aur makeup ke neeche achha option
- Approx. **₹350–₹400** range mein mil raha hai. [www.buyrn.in](https://www.buyrn.in/article/best-sunscreen-india-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar skin oily hai
### [Dot & Key Watermelon Cooling Sunscreen]()
*₹387*

Water-light gel texture, non-greasy finish aur **zero-white-cast** claim; humid Indian weather mein particularly convenient. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/blogs/skin-care/dermatologist-recommended-sunscreens-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar dry/normal skin hai
**Dot & Key Vitamin C + E SPF 50+ PA++++** — lightweight/dewy finish aur no-white-cast finish. Iska SPF independently in-vivo tested bhi reported hai. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/products/dot-key-vitamin-c-e-spf-50-pa-face-sunscreen-for-glowing-skin-uv-protection-for-dull-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Short answer:** Agar tum mujhe bina aur details ke ek hi sunscreen choose karne bolo, toh **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++** lunga.

Agar tum mujhe bata do **tumhari skin oily, dry ya combination hai + budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)**, toh main tumhare liye **2–3 exact best options** compare karke bata deta hoon.
